$$

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-1 \\ x_{2} &=-1 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & 3\end{array}\right]

$$
